prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I did that quick high-speed rail hop from Beijing to Shanghai, and it still cracks me up how early I had to be up.
For sightseeing, Chengdu was the easiest city to just wander around and keep stumbling into something interesting.
And in Wuhan, I remember my cousin talking nonstop about hotels there like it was a whole hobby.
That Beijing–Shanghai leg was on train G1, and I’m pretty sure it was on 2025-03-16.
The ticket was under Xie Peng, and it was just Second Class—nothing fancy, but totally fine.
In Chengdu, my friend Mason White had already set up a morning visit to Du Fu Thatched Cottage for 2025-04-18, so we just tagged along.

Oh, and in Wuhan they stayed at Wanda Realm Wuhan—check-in was 2025-03-22 for 1 night, and it was under Zhao Min; there were 4 of us for that Du Fu place earlier, which felt like a whole mini field trip.
